events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Barnes (SAS) attempts to pass the ball to his teammate, which results in Sochan (SAS) touching it last before the ball goes out of bounds. Philadelphia is correctly awarded possession.
Edwards (PHI) brings both hands to Castle (SAS) and marginal contact occurs as Castle maintains his dribble in the perimeter.
Yabusele (PHI) establishes himself in Castle's (SAS) path and absorbs the marginal contact.
Butler (PHI) reaches in and initiates contact with Vassell's (SAS) arm, affecting his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Butler (PHI) inbounds the ball with five seconds.
Castle (SAS) makes contact with the ball during the inbound pass and dislodges it away from Grimes' (PHI) before incidental contact occurs to his arm.
Yabusele (PHI) is retreating his arm into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs with Castle (SAS) after his gather.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Grimes (PHI) loses control of the ball during his drive to the basket, and he is the last to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. SAS is correctly awarded possession.
